settings.device.label: Audio device
settings.device.description: Where OxiTide plays. Exclusive bypasses the system mixer so samples reach the device unchanged; other apps can't use it meanwhile, and the in-app volume stays at 100% (set the level on your DAC or with the system volume). Pinned devices also appear in the player bar's quality menu.

settings.exclusiveFallback.description: For every device in Exclusive mode: when the device refuses exclusive mode, or has no volume control of its own (exclusive would then play at full volume; the fallback uses the in-app volume instead, which is not bit-perfect).

settings.blockExplicit.description: Hides explicit tracks and blocks them from playing. Enabling clears the current queue, matching the official app.
settings.blockAi.label: Block AI-generated content
settings.blockAi.description: Hides tracks TIDAL labels as AI-generated and removes them from the queue. Labels may be missing for some tracks or regions; those play normally.

settings.showLabels.description: Tags explicit tracks with E and AI-generated tracks with AI, even when not blocking them. Turning this off stops the background label lookups too.

settings.startMini.label: Start in mini player
settings.startMini.description: Open as the compact mini player instead of the full window.

settings.lastTransition.label: Last transition

settings.automixReplay.description: Let a track end on its own with AutoMix on, then compare the same pair in each style. Replays pause playback and keep ReplayGain but skip EQ.
